title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, 7 October 2026
description: A fast-food chain under scrutiny over unlabelled imported pork and a contested Sydney bus lane proposal, a hopeful northern quoll release in north Queensland and the housing squeeze facing single-income households, plus the Gold Coast's build-up to the Rugby League World Cup and the World Masters Golf Championship. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
